messages.content: This is the Radial Action Menu sample: a quick-action menu for Uno Platform built to the Control Gallery prototype, on a Contacts panel.

Radial Action Menu is one Uno single project, `RadialActionMenuDemo/RadialActionMenuDemo.csproj` (Uno.Sdk 7.0.22 from `global.json`; heads net10.0-android, net10.0-browserwasm and net10.0-desktop; UnoFeatures Material, Toolkit, Logging, SkiaRenderer). No MVVM or Navigation: `App.xaml.cs` navigates a Frame to `MainPage` and stores it in `App.AppRoot`; the app follows the system theme.

**Key files:**
- `Controls/RadialActionMenu.cs`: templated Control. DPs Items (ObservableCollection<RadialMenuItemData>, max 5), Position (MenuPosition BottomRight/BottomLeft/TopRight/TopLeft/Center), IsOpen, Radius (208), DiscSize (52), TriggerSize (64), EdgeMargin (24), ShowLabels, TriggerLabel, IsHintVisible, HighlightedIndex (+ read-only HighlightedLabel/HighlightedKey); Open/Close/Toggle; events Opening, Opened, Closing, Closed, ItemSelected. Creates one RadialActionMenuItem per data item in PART_Canvas, places each by its disc centre on the arc, builds the dotted guide (ArcSegment) and runs the open/close storyboards in code (KeySplines 0.2,0.9 0.3,1 out and 0.4,0 1,1 back). PreviewKeyDown handles 1-5, arrows and Esc; trigger pointer handlers (handledEventsToo) implement slide-to-pick; hover or keyboard focus shows the hint. Visual state groups OpenStates, HintStates, SlideStates.
- `Controls/RadialActionMenuItem.cs`: a Button subclass: Label, KeyLabel, IconData (Geometry parsed from path data), DiscSize, IconSize, Placement (LabelPlacement Left/Right/Above/Below/BadgeOnly), IsHighlighted, DiscCenter; visual state groups CommonStates (hover white disc, pressed ink, disabled 40%), KeyboardFocusStates (ring + inverted pill), LabelStates, HighlightStates.
- `Controls/RadialActionMenu.xaml`: both default styles, the trigger style and tokens (chip, guide, scrim, hover colours per theme; other colours alias PrimaryBrush, OnSurfaceBrush, OnSurfaceVariantBrush, OutlineBrush, OutlineVariantBrush). Shadows are radial-gradient ellipses (the Toolkit ShadowContainer left stale pixels on Skia when the focus look changed).
- `Controls/RadialMenuItemData.cs` (Icon path data, Label, Command, CommandParameter, IsEnabled), `MenuPosition.cs`, `LabelPlacement.cs`, `RadialMenuIcons.cs` (Tabler paths and the demo's five actions).
- `Styles/ColorPaletteOverride.xaml` (33 roles; Light from the prototype, Dark derived), `Styles/MaterialFontsOverride.xaml` (DefaultFontFamily = Archivo with `Assets/Fonts/Archivo-Regular.ttf.manifest` for 400/600), `Styles/Typography.xaml` (Archivo Bold Expanded DisplayTitle). Licence: `Assets/Fonts/OFL-Archivo.txt`.
- `MainPage.xaml(.cs)`: the Contacts panel, a status line (LiveSetting Polite) and the menu; `{utu:Responsive}` sets DiscSize 56/52, Radius 172/208 and ShowLabels False/True below/above 600 px; a Toolkit filter Chip is the Dark switch (`SystemThemeHelper.SetRootTheme(App.AppRoot ?? page, ...)`).
- `HotDesignPreviews/` (Debug only): RadialClosedPreview, RadialHintPreview, RadialOpeningPreview, RadialOpenPreview, RadialLeftEdgePreview, RadialTouchSlidePreview; each gets the items from `RadialMenuIcons.ContactActions` through LoadDataContext.

**Build:** `dotnet build RadialActionMenuDemo/RadialActionMenuDemo.csproj -f net10.0-desktop`.

The app is built and running. The user may ask me to modify it.
